description: On weekends and weeknights, volunteers and canvassers have been pounding the pavement to help build support for Laura Ellman’s state senate campaign. Thanks to the hard work of dozens of supporters, the campaign has been able to reach over 15,000 of our neighbors this summer. We have teamed up with other local campaigns and organizations to have the biggest impact. …
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ELLMAN FOR IL SENATE D21
title: Volunteers Knock Thousands of Doors for Laura Ellman's Campaign - Laura Ellman
